notes: Adds one optional Workspace- and Brand-scoped presenter profile; no presenter is created implicitly.
Presenter profile stores descriptive presentation preferences only. This slice does not accept biometric enrollment, raw face/voice cloning media or provider secrets.
Creation may reference an eligible ready presenter through a nullable durable presenterId; None remains the default and existing creation behavior remains valid.
Avatar is a Brand sub-surface only and must follow product/DESIGN.md before repository design skills.
No AvatarProvider implementation, worker/media-orchestrator change, provider credential/configuration change or generated test clip is authorized.
Existing tenant isolation, human approval, exact Preview, publishing and channel credential boundaries remain unchanged.

VS-89 remains released and in post-release observation; its authenticated Brand/Channels visual smoke is still pending because no valid production test session is available to connected tooling and must not be represented as validated.

approvals.rationale: The Product Owner said Go after the bounded next sequence was stated: preserve truthful VS-89 observation, then start the approved Avatar / Presenter work under DESIGN.md and existing provider boundaries.
The slice reuses existing Brand tenant isolation, sensitive-data, provider credential and human publishing approval policies; it does not authorize a provider or new autonomous policy.
The Product Owner explicitly instructed the Avatar / Presenter implementation to proceed after the production observation boundary was explained.
Requires one immutable candidate with Product Intake, Security, CI, migration, preflight and design-quality evidence plus explicit Product Owner certification approval.
No release is authorized by the implementation Go.
No production deployment is authorized by the implementation Go.
